description_en: Information about the silo: • Total area: 895m2 • Warehouse area: 695 m². • Area of ​​offices: 200m2 (organized on two floors) • 1-story structure. • Height 9m at the top and 8-30m at the arches. Organization: • Open space • 4 dedicated office spaces. • 4 Toilets. • 1 invested and furnished studio for staff accommodation. Other settings: • Side of the road. • Regular cubature. • Glass facade. • Invested. • Supplied with shelves. • Possibility of parking 15-20 cars. • 24h water and electricity. • Concrete + silicate brick construction • Favorable geographical position. • Suitable for different types of business. • Well managed silo complex. • Connection to the main national transport accesses. • With regular mortgage documentation.
